questions.stem: A 30-year-old woman came to OPD with a complaint of constipation. One week earlier, she developed a sore throat and a dry, nonproductive cough and was diagnosed with acute bronchitis. Drug treatment was started, and the cough gradually disappeared. Which of the following drugs most likely caused the constipation reported by the patient?
questions.solutionHtml:
Codeine
  • Codeine is commonly used as an antitussive when a dry, nonproductive cough is disturbing the patient. Most opioids can cause constipation when used repeatedly, as in this case.
  • MOA



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 502-506

questions.stem: A 30-year-old man presents to an urgent care clinic with a dry cough for the past week. The cough was associated with a fever and chills for 2 days, but he has since been afebrile. He has no other symptoms. What opioid is most appropriate to treat this patient's cough?
questions.solutionHtml:
Dextromethorphan

Dextromethorphan is an opioid used for cough suppression. It exhibits its cough suppressant properties by acting centrally on the cough centre in the medulla.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 239-240

questions.stem: A 20-year-old man presents to the casualty with a persistent cough and nasal congestion. He has been taking various prescription cough and cold medicines but did not know their names. A urine drug screen is positive for amphetamines. When confronted with this information, he vehemently denies amphetamine use. What is the best explanation?

options.label: A
options.text: He had a false positive because of codeine use

options.label: B
options.text: He had a false positive because of ephedrine use

options.label: C
options.text: He had a false positive because of marijuana use

options.label: D
options.text: He is lying about drug use

questions.answerText: He had a false positive because of ephedrine use
questions.solutionHtml:
He had a false positive because of ephedrine use
  • Ephedrine is a vasoconstrictor used to treat nasal congestion and can cause a false-positive amphetamine drug test. Codeine, present in many cough medicines, would cause a positive drug test for opioids.
  • This patient’s recent use of prescription cough and cold medicines could be expected to produce false positives in a urine drug screen in this manner.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 243

questions.stem: Rajesh 28-year-old man presents to the OPD for a follow-up of his asthma. He has had asthma since he was 8 years old and requires daily treatment for his symptoms. He often has nighttime awakenings with coughing spells. On physical exam, diffuse wheezing is heard bilaterally. He is willing to try anything to improve his symptoms. The physician decides to add Cromolyn to his regimen. What is the mechanism of action of cromolyn?
questions.solutionHtml:
Mast cell stabilizer

Cromolyn is a mast cell stabilizer preventing the release of inflammatory mediators. It is dosed many times throughout the day and does not offer much benefit. For this reason, cromolyn is rarely used to treat asthma.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 249

questions.stem: A 60-year-old man with long-standing hypertension on enalapril presents to an OPD physician complaining of a chronic cough. The cough began when he started this medication. The most likely explanation for this finding is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Bradykinin stimulation

Common side effects include dry cough, rash, fever, altered taste, hypotension (in hypovolemic states), and hyperkalemia. The dry cough, which occurs in about 10% of patients, is thought to be caused by increased levels of bradykinin in the pulmonary tree. It occurs more frequently in women and nonsmokers and with longer-acting ACE inhibitors.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 553
